items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
items.desc: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

items.name: Eslabong
items.desc: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

items.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
items.desc: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

items.name: Here Comes the Horde
items.desc: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

items.name: Sol One
items.sub: yeetgench · Early Access, Indie, Open World Survival Craft
items.desc: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

items.name: 9 Kings
items.desc: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

items.name: just volleyball
items.desc: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

items.name: Slotbound
items.sub: Optima Arch · Strategy, Auto Battler, Rogue-like
items.desc: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: ForgeTax
items.desc: Forge swords to pay a dragon in this first-person forging roguelite. Stop while your blade still holds, or risk one more strike. Trade swords for relics that change the odds. One day, you might get to use a blade of your own against the dragon.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: over the hill
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: Order of the Sinking Star
items.desc: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

items.sub: Shiny Shoe · Strategy, Card Game, Rogue-like
items.desc: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

items.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
items.desc: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

items.name: Escape From Duckov

items.name: Eslabong
items.desc: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

items.name: Fast Food Simulator
items.sub: No Ceiling Games · Simulation, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer
items.desc: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

items.name: Leaf it Alone
items.desc: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of movie and video game rentals!

items.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
items.desc: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

items.name: Single File
items.desc: A pixel-art auto-battler. You get one save file. If your party wipes, it's deleted and you start over. Not quite from zero though cause the Scrolls you earned stay, and they make every new file stronger. Grow a party of six. Use their abilities. Fight against 36 bosses.

items.name: ArcaneBound
items.desc: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

items.name: Goblin Island
items.desc: You left your job for a relaxed farm life, but you can’t stop scrolling. Plant, water and harvest crops, chase rare mutations and hire goblin companions. Resist the urge to check your phone, grow your focus, and turn a humble plot into a goblin farming empire.

items.name: Dice
items.desc: Throw dices. That's just it. You click, and throw dices, a bunch of them in fact. Score as much as you can doing suites, pairs and more, earn golds, buy dices, throw more.
